One grey morning, while clearing sand from the landing steps, he noticed a glass bottle wedged between two stones. Its cork was sealed with wax, and inside, a sheet of paper had been rolled tightly and tied with faded red thread. He carefully opened it at the kitchen table. The handwriting was small and careful: 'If you are reading this, the tide has carried me farther than I hoped. Please tell my daughter I found the island.' There was no name and no date. Tomas folded the note, placed it in his coat pocket, and walked to the village that afternoon. He had a feeling someone there would recognise the words, and he wanted to keep his promise to deliver them.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市仍未醒来。街灯一盏盏亮着，像被遗忘的星星，安静地照着空荡的马路。偶尔有一辆外卖车呼啸而过，轮胎摩擦湿润的路面，发出短促的声响。高楼的窗户大多暗着，只有少数几扇还亮着灯，那里或许有人在加班，或许有人彻夜难眠。早点摊的老板已经开始忙碌，蒸笼冒出白色的热气，在灯光下缓缓升腾。远处的河面泛着微光，桥上几乎没有行人。这个时刻，城市像是在深深呼吸，等待着第一缕晨光，等待着新一天的喧闹重新开始。", "w03": "- Recursion means a function calls itself to solve a problem.\n- It breaks a big problem into smaller copies of the same problem.\n- It stops when it reaches a simple case that can be answered directly."}
